title: 第215章 一边倒
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

夜黑得深沉，一把大火点燃整个夜空，数万黑甲军铁蹄如同天上坠落的星斗，无情的践踏着北燕军营。

任何时候都没有死亡来临那般令人清醒，联军将士们被无情的大火和冰冷的刀锋吓醒了。

叮叮当当……

兵戈四起，联军为时不长的安逸被打破，即便头脑清醒，可身子在酒精的作用下变得迟缓，根本抵挡不住黑甲军那无情的刀锋。

“啊……不好啦，敌军杀过来了……啊……”

放眼战场，根本就不是什么势均力敌，完全是一边倒的屠杀，外围大营尽陷于火海之中。

位于正中央的统帅大营，孟良与殷夺魁正推杯换盏，各自抒发着心中不悦，突然闻得帐外纷乱，不得放下酒杯。

“何事如此慌乱？”

殷夺魁说了句，但却没人回答，这在以往是不可能的。

“人呢，人都去哪了，到底怎么回事！”

说着话，殷夺魁站起身向帐外走去一看究竟。

可还没走几步，帐帘撩起，一个血葫芦一样的人好像被推进来一般，直接扑到殷夺魁身上。

“大……大帅……不好了……黑甲军……突……袭……军……营！”

说完，这人瞳孔涣散，栽倒在地，断了气。

一股冷气由打脖颈游遍全身，殷夺魁冷汗冒出来，那些所谓的微醺郁闷烟消云散，取而代之的则是无尽的疑惑。

黑甲军不是撤离了吗，怎么可能再杀个回马枪？再说安阳已经被北燕占领，他们放弃帝都于不顾跟我较什么劲！

孟良听得清楚，纵然比殷夺魁精明一些，但还是没想到会发生这样的事。

“大帅，发生什么事？”

殷夺魁看了一眼，一字一顿道：“黑甲军突袭军营，现在一片混乱，不知道怎么回事。”

“他们不是撤退吗，怎么又返回来了！”

“谁说不是呢，天知道怎么又返回来了，孟兄，我心已乱，现在该如何是好！”

孟良一屁股坐下，还能怎么办，人家都打到头上来了，只能应敌。

“大帅莫慌，就兵力而言，我军还是处于上风，他们来了也好，正好胸中闷气撒在他们头上！？”

“嗯，也好，我就不信他黑甲军还能翻了天不成！来呀，擂鼓聚将！”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The night was so dark that a fire ignited the entire night sky. The iron hooves of tens of thousands of black-armored troops were like stars falling from the sky, trampling the Beiyan military camp mercilessly.

There is no time as sobering as the coming of death. The coalition soldiers were frightened awake by the ruthless fire and the cold blade.

Ding-ding-ding-ding-ding...

Fighting broke out everywhere, and the short-lived comfort of the coalition forces was broken. Even if their minds were clear, their bodies became sluggish under the influence of alcohol, and they could not withstand the ruthless blade of the black armor army.

"Ah...no, the enemy is coming...ah..."

Looking at the battlefield, it was not evenly matched at all, it was a one-sided massacre, and the outer camp was engulfed in a sea of fire.

In the commander's camp located in the center, Meng Liang and Yin Duokui were changing glasses, expressing their displeasure when they suddenly heard the commotion outside the tent and were unable to put down their glasses.

"Why are you so confused?"

Yin Duokui said something, but no one answered. This was impossible in the past.

"Where are the people? Where have they gone? What's going on!"

As he spoke, Yin Duokui stood up and walked outside the tent to take a look.

But before he had walked a few steps, the curtain was lifted up, and a man who looked like a bloody gourd seemed to be pushed in and jumped directly on Yin Duokui.

"Big... Commander... Something's wrong... The Black Armored Army... suddenly... attacks... the... army... camp!"

After saying that, the man's pupils were dilated, he fell to the ground and died.

A stream of cold air spread all over his body from the blow on his neck, and Yin Duokui broke out in cold sweat. The so-called drunkenness and depression disappeared, replaced by endless doubts.

Didn't the Black Armored Army retreat? How could they come back and fight back?Besides, Anyang has been occupied by Beiyan. They abandoned the imperial capital and didn't care about competing with me!

Meng Liang heard clearly. Even though he was smarter than Yin Duokui, he still didn't expect such a thing to happen.

"Commander, what happened?"

Yin Duokui took a look and said word by word: "The Black Armored Army raided the military camp. It's a mess now. I don't know what's going on."

"Didn't they retreat? Why did they come back again!"

"Who says it's not the case? God knows why he came back again. Brother Meng, I'm confused. What should I do now?"

Meng Liang sat down, what else could he do, everyone had hit him on the head, so he could only respond to the enemy.

"Commander, don't panic. In terms of military strength, our army still has the upper hand. It doesn't matter if they come, the trouble in your chest will just happen to them!?"

"Well, that's fine, I don't believe that his black-armored army can turn the world upside down! Come on, beat the drum and gather the generals!"
